name: ttthresh-v1
run: cd /work && python -m py_compile ttthresh_core.py ttthresh_job.py test_ttthresh_core.py > /out/compile.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/compile.txt; exit $rc
cd /work && python -m unittest -v test_ttthresh_core > /out/tests.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/tests.txt; exit $rc
cd /work && sha256sum ttthresh_core.py ttthresh_job.py test_ttthresh_core.py PREREG-v0.1.md requirements.txt | tee /out/sha256.txt
cd /work && python ttthresh_job.py --data-dir /data --out /out > /out/run.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E '^TT_' /out/run.txt; tail -n 40 /out/run.txt; exit $rc
